stations.note: Bookings come in with no class.

stations.title: Booking form
stations.text: Name, email and places, and nothing else.

stations.title: Your HTML
stations.gap: No way to pick an answer

captions: Kofi gets bookings, but he cannot tell which class they are for.
The form only asks for a name, an email and places, and it can be sent empty.
You add a menu, radio buttons, a checkbox, a notes box and required answers.
A booking arrives with the class, the experience and every answer Kofi needs.
The classes page now shows the timetable and takes a full booking.
